title: Polti — The Thirty-Six Dramatic Situations
source: Georges Polti, The Thirty-Six Dramatic Situations (English tr. Lucille Ray, 1916)
license: public domain (1916 translation); descriptions authored/paraphrased for monomyth
tier_note: Adopted wholesale as a conflict/encounter enum. Each situation names the roles ('dynamic elements') it requires — these map onto encounter templates whose slots the generator fills.

items.name: Supplication
items.description: A suppliant pleads with a power whose decision is uncertain, against a persecutor.

items.name: Deliverance
items.description: An unfortunate is saved from a threatener by an unexpected rescuer.

items.name: Crime Pursued by Vengeance
items.description: An avenger pursues and punishes a criminal for a wrong done.

items.name: Vengeance Taken for Kin upon Kin
items.description: One relative avenges a wronged relative by striking at a guilty relative.

items.name: Pursuit
items.description: A fugitive flees punishment or a relentless pursuer.

items.name: Disaster
items.description: A power is overthrown; catastrophe befalls the once-mighty.

items.name: Falling Prey to Cruelty or Misfortune
items.description: A helpless victim suffers at the hands of a cruel master or blind misfortune.

items.name: Revolt
items.description: One or many conspire and rise against an oppressive power.

items.name: Daring Enterprise
items.description: A bold leader undertakes a hazardous venture to seize an object against an adversary.

items.name: Abduction
items.description: A person is carried off from a guardian by an abductor.

items.name: The Enigma
items.description: A seeker must solve a riddle or problem set by an interrogator, often on pain of death.

items.name: Obtaining
items.description: Something is won by persuasion or force over one who refuses, sometimes via an arbitrator.

items.name: Enmity of Kin
items.description: Hatred divides those bound by blood.

items.name: Rivalry of Kin
items.description: Relatives compete for the same object of desire.

items.name: Murderous Adultery
items.description: Two lovers conspire to kill the betrayed spouse who stands between them.

items.name: Madness
items.description: One driven mad brings harm upon a victim.

items.name: Fatal Imprudence
items.description: A careless act by one brings ruin upon themselves or another.

items.name: Involuntary Crimes of Love
items.description: Lovers discover, too late, a forbidden bond (e.g., unknowing incest) they did not intend.

items.name: Slaying of a Kinsman Unrecognized
items.description: One kills a relative without recognizing them, learning the truth after.

items.name: Self-Sacrifice for an Ideal
items.description: A hero gives up all — even life — for a cause or belief.

items.name: Self-Sacrifice for Kindred
items.description: A hero sacrifices themselves or their interests for a loved one.

items.name: All Sacrificed for a Passion
items.description: Everything is thrown away for the sake of an overwhelming passion.

items.name: Necessity of Sacrificing Loved Ones
items.description: Circumstance forces a hero to sacrifice one they love.

items.name: Rivalry of Superior and Inferior
items.description: An unequal pair — in rank, power, or fortune — compete for the same prize.

items.name: Adultery
items.description: A spouse is betrayed by their partner and a third party.

items.name: Crimes of Love
items.description: A love that transgresses law or taboo (in kind, age, or bond).

items.name: Discovery of the Dishonor of a Loved One
items.description: One learns that a loved one has committed a shameful act.

items.name: Obstacles to Love
items.description: Lovers are kept apart by an obstacle (family, station, circumstance).

items.name: An Enemy Loved
items.description: One loves a person who belongs to the enemy side, torn between love and loyalty.

items.name: Ambition
items.description: A driving ambition brings one into conflict with those who would restrain it.

items.name: Conflict with a God
items.description: A mortal contends against, defies, or is punished by a divine power.

items.name: Mistaken Jealousy
items.description: Jealousy founded on a mistake drives one to ruinous action.

items.name: Erroneous Judgment
items.description: A false conclusion condemns the innocent while the guilty go free.

items.name: Remorse
items.description: A culprit is tormented by conscience over a past deed.

items.name: Recovery of a Lost One
items.description: A lost person is sought and at last found again.

items.name: Loss of Loved Ones
items.description: One helplessly witnesses or endures the loss of loved ones.
